metadata.title: NAP-001: Plasmid DNA Extraction with QIAGEN QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit
metadata.purpose: Extract plasmid DNA by the QIAprep Spin Miniprep spin-column procedure for cloning, sequencing, ligation, transformation, and screening workflows.
metadata.scope: Training/library SOP draft for the selected miniprep procedure. Midiprep is out of scope because buffer volumes and columns differ. Confirm the current manufacturer protocol, SDS, and local EHS rules before bench use.
beforeYouBegin: Use fresh selective culture and avoid severely overgrown cultures, mixed colonies, or wrong antibiotic selection.
Check that RNase A has been added to Buffer P1 and ethanol has been added to Buffer PE.
Equilibrate Buffer P1 and N3 if precipitates are present; dissolve SDS precipitate in Buffer P2 by warming and mixing before use.

materials.name: Overnight E. coli culture carrying plasmid
QIAGEN Buffer P1 with RNase A
materials.specification: Confirm RNase A has been added

materials.name: QIAGEN Buffer P2
materials.specification: Warm and mix to dissolve SDS precipitate before use if present

materials.name: QIAGEN Buffer PB
materials.specification: Optional wash for endA+ strains or nuclease-rich material

materials.name: QIAGEN Buffer PE
materials.specification: Ethanol must be added before use

materials.name: LyseBlue reagent
materials.specification: Optional visual monitor for lysis and neutralization

materials.name: Purified plasmid DNA
materials.storage: Store at -20 deg C for long-term storage, or at 4 deg C for short-term use if laboratory policy allows

equipment.name: Microcentrifuge
equipment.settings: Capable of approximately 13,000 rpm / 17,900 x g

tables.title: Run Record Template
rows: Catalog, lot, expiration, and buffer prep notes
tables.note: Blank run-record template provided in the source PDF.

steps.action: Pellet the recommended culture volume by centrifugation and remove all supernatant so the pellet is not diluted before resuspension.
Resuspend the bacterial pellet completely in Buffer P1 by pipetting or vortexing until no clumps remain.
Add Buffer P2 and mix gently by inversion until the suspension becomes clear and viscous.
steps.criticalNotes: Do not vortex after adding Buffer P2.

steps.action: Incubate at room temperature only as allowed by the manufacturer protocol.
steps.criticalNotes: Do not exceed the lysis time limit.

steps.action: Add Buffer N3 and immediately invert until the mixture is homogeneous and a white precipitate forms.
steps.expectedResult: Homogeneous mixture with a white precipitate.

steps.action: Centrifuge the lysate to pellet cellular debris and chromosomal DNA/protein/SDS precipitate.

parameters.rawText: maximum microcentrifuge speed; approximately 13,000 rpm / 17,900 x g

steps.action: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a QIAprep spin column.
steps.criticalNotes: Avoid disturbing or transferring the white pellet.

steps.action: Centrifuge the column and discard flow-through.
For endA+ strains or nuclease-rich material, wash the column with Buffer PB and centrifuge.
Wash the column with Buffer PE, centrifuge, and discard flow-through.
Centrifuge the empty column to remove residual ethanol.
Place the column in a clean microcentrifuge tube and add Buffer EB or nuclease-free water to the center of the membrane.

parameters.rawText: 50 uL Buffer EB or nuclease-free water

steps.criticalNotes: Use one stated eluent; the source gives Buffer EB or nuclease-free water.

steps.action: Let the column stand, then centrifuge to elute plasmid DNA.
Measure concentration and purity ratios, then document downstream integrity checks and storage location.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Expected plasmid A260/A280 is often near 1.8.

steps.expectedResult: Concentration, A260/A280, A260/A230, and storage are recorded.

controls.name: Analytical gel or diagnostic restriction digest
Sanger sequencing across insert/junctions
controls.description: Submit before using the clone as a final validated construct.

expectedOutputs: Recorded concentration and A260/A280 / A260/A230 purity ratios.
Analytical gel or diagnostic digest and sequencing result for a new clone where applicable.

troubleshooting.cause: Low-copy plasmid, poor growth, incomplete resuspension, or overloaded column.
troubleshooting.solution: Use a fresh colony, correct antibiotic, kit-valid culture volume, and fully resuspend before Buffer P2.

troubleshooting.cause: Vortexing after lysis or harsh handling of viscous lysate.
troubleshooting.solution: Invert gently after P2/N3 and avoid scraping the pellet when transferring supernatant.
Use the full PE wash and dry spin; avoid the column tip touching flow-through.

troubleshooting.cause: Template too dilute or dirty, primer issue, or mixed colony.
troubleshooting.solution: Quantify, re-clean or repeat miniprep from a single colony, and verify primer.

safety: Wear a lab coat, gloves, and eye protection.
Use nuclease-free tubes and filtered tips.
Confirm ethanol has been added to wash-buffer concentrates when required and mark the bottle with date, initials, and ethanol volume added.
